text: you need to do it for the compiled game loader also
resolution: Made cooked stairs/ramp pieces walkable in the COMPILED no-V8 game too (req_1700 fixed only the editor play view). Root cause: the compiled COLLIDERS lump already carried the walkable slope (buildBakedColliders calls placedPieceRamps, which req_1700 taught to include cooked stairs), but world_loader.zig ALSO derives a box collider per mesh-prop instance (islandOrientedFloats ~line 1735) layered on top — so the slope existed but a solid box re-blocked it. Fix is bake-side and minimal: compile/worldGeometry.ts cookedPropMesh now ships a stairs/ramp-typed cooked piece's MESH_PROPS mesh as solid:false; the loader's meshPropIslands already returns NO islands for a non-solid mesh, so no box is derived and collision falls to the COLLIDERS-lump walkable slope. Rendering is unaffected (the mesh still draws). Verified: meshProps 1/1, worldColliders 6/6, worldParity 15/15, plus the req_1700 cookedPiece 7/7 + placed 57/57 still green. The user must RE-BAKE (rjit game bake) for the new gamefile to take effect. Caveat: bakeMassiveGameFile drops the COLLIDERS lump (a scale-lab path), so there the slope wouldn't ship — separate follow-up if that path matters. Sha 381eb1b9b.
